entries.name: WarpShaders.metallib
entries.role: Spatial computing / XR compositor and spatial media shaders
entries.note: visionOS-style immersive rendering; BifrOSt has no XR compositor; low priority unless spatial media is wanted. role inferred from the owning framework path; the metallib was not disassembled

entries.name: WeatherMapsMetalLib.metallib
entries.role: Effects shader of WeatherMaps (app or system UI animation)
entries.note: WeatherMaps UI effect shader (animations, gradients, glows); BifrOSt apps draw their own UI with the shape/glass pipeline and have no equivalent per-effect shader. role inferred from the owning framework path; the metallib was not disassembled
